parsed.notes: The filing gives no actual ratio values, only the requirements. The limits shown are the Further Extended Covenant Relief Period levels under the Sixth Amendment, which applied at the 2026-09-26 quarter end. The adjusted debt to EBITDAR maximum could have risen to 5.00x after a qualified acquisition. The old Credit Facility was repaid and terminated on October 23, 2026, and replaced by a new Ares-agented Credit Agreement. That agreement has a maximum lease adjusted net leverage ratio stepping down from 7.50x (Q4 FY2027) to 7.25x (FY2028), 7.00x (FY2029), 6.75x (FY2030) and 6.50x (FY2031 onward). It also has a minimum average daily liquidity test of $20M from Q4 FY2027 through Q2 FY2028, then $25M. These new covenants were not yet tested at the period end, so they are not listed as entries. The fixed charge coverage ratio under the new agreement relates only to the dividend restriction.
